fullSheets.name: Intro
rows: No longer updated, fight the power
These are all Halo Infinite Seasons, set onto one page. I hope you enjoy.

Stats from Season 2 and Season 3 PLAYOFFS, do not exist. I could not find them, if an admin knows something, please send them over. I did however manually fix the wins and losses so that is factored in for those playoff series.
I recommend taking into account that each season was different, so some seasons may have different variance among other things.
Also, you can go to "Data, Create Filter View" to make your own personal filters.
If you find something wrong or want something included, DM "yLuxe" on discord.
